chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Harun ibn Muslim ibn Sa'dan, from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving the source lineage of the hadith material in the book.
